speaker: consultant
text: Hello, Elena Ward speaking.

speaker: customer
text: Hi Elena, it is David Chen. I am calling about my Growth Package.

speaker: consultant
text: Hi David, good to hear from you. What can I do for you?

speaker: customer
text: This is a bit awkward. My company is being bought by a larger firm, and the new owners have their own advisors. So I need to cancel the rest of my package.

speaker: consultant
text: I understand, and congratulations on the sale. That is a big step. Let me check your account. You bought the package five weeks ago and we have used two of the six sessions.

speaker: customer
text: That is right. Do I get anything back for the four sessions I did not use?

speaker: consultant
text: Yes. The full refund applies only in the first fourteen days, and only if no sessions were used. After that, you get a pro rata refund for the unused sessions, minus a fifty dollar admin fee.

speaker: customer
text: So how much is that in my case?

speaker: consultant
text: You paid nine hundred and fifty dollars upfront. Four unused sessions out of six is about six hundred and thirty-three dollars. Minus the fifty dollar fee, the refund is five hundred and eighty-three dollars.

speaker: customer
text: Okay. I was hoping there would be no fee, but I understand it was in the terms.

speaker: consultant
text: It covers the admin work and the preparation I already did for the next sessions. I hope that feels fair.

speaker: customer
text: Yes, it is fair. How long does the refund take?

speaker: consultant
text: I will process it today. It goes back to the card you paid with, and it usually arrives within five to seven business days.

speaker: customer
text: Good. And what about the action plan you sent me? Can I still use it?

speaker: consultant
text: Of course, the action plan is yours. You can share it with the new owners if it helps.

speaker: customer
text: That is kind of you. The pricing section was really helpful, actually.

speaker: consultant
text: I am glad. If you ever start a new business, my door is open.

speaker: customer
text: I will keep that in mind. So we are done after today?

speaker: consultant
text: Yes. I will send you a written confirmation of the cancellation and the refund amount by email.

speaker: customer
text: Thank you, Elena. Sorry it ended early.

speaker: consultant
text: No need to apologize, David. Good luck with the transition.
